notes.title: Patch 1.1 – Interface Improvements & World Selection Update
notes.notes:
This update brings several quality-of-life improvements to the user interface, alongside a brand-new feature that enhances game navigation:

Improved Interface Navigation: Refactored internal code to ensure smoother and more consistent navigation across all menus and UI elements.

Updated Icons: Several icons have been redesigned for better visual clarity and a more cohesive art style.

New World Selection Screen: Added a dedicated section for world selection, making it easier for players to choose their desired environment before starting the game.

More enhancements are on the way—thank you for your continued support!
